caption: A car approaches from behind a parked car, and its image appears in the parked car's side mirror and grows larger.

sa.check: A car approaches from behind a parked car.
Its image appears in the parked car's side mirror.
The image leaves the mirror as the car draws alongside.

pc.expect: The image appears in the mirror before the car passes and grows as it nears.
pc.fail: It stays one size; or shrinks as the car nears; or appears only after the car has passed.

pc.expect: The image is a mirror image of the approaching car, seen behind.
pc.fail: It is a different car; or it shows the road ahead; or it is upside down.

pc.expect: The image moves only as the car moves.
pc.fail: It jumps; or moves with the car stopped; or drifts.

pc.expect: The mirror is rigid: the image is undistorted.
pc.fail: The mirror ripples; or the image warps; or the mirror bends.

pc.expect: Two cars and one image of the approaching one.
pc.fail: A third car appears; or the image leaves the mirror; or a car vanishes; or the cars pass through each other.

pc.expect: The cars' colours and the street stay the same.
pc.fail: A car changes colour; or the mirror changes; or the street rearranges.
